intro: A Humble Task is an introductory rite of service in Red Cloud Mesa, where an elder tests a fledgling adventurer's humility and diligence. By carrying fresh well water across the plains to Camp Narache's leader, young tauren learn that serving their people starts with the simplest duties.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.
But you look like an eager adventurer. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.
Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.
Your willingness to help others and provide for the tauren of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
